**Date:** Tuesday 10 November 2026  
**Time:** 09:00 - 10:30  
**Venue:** QT Perth, Murray Room

**Chair:** Mark Gibberd

## Summary

Hear how the Curtin AAGI node supports industry responses to spatial variability, advances multivariate spatial modelling and bioinformatics, and applies analytics to gene-trait research and soilborne disease. The program also covers analytical thinking in research practice and new initiatives at AAGI Curtin.
